demo.selection_note: Player, dates, thresholds and warmup are illustrative project choices made after historical data were available; never an untouched confirmatory test.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block percentile bootstrap in chronological game order
bootstrap.limitations: Exploratory intervals only; five-game dependence horizon is assumed, not established. No adjustment for selection, player/window choice or multiple comparisons; no confirmatory p-values reported.

competition.primary_score: lower 95% date-block-bootstrap bound on net return per unit staked
competition.single_bet_exemption: G05 may be explicitly not applicable with an artifact; never silently passed
competition.correction: Holm over every registered attempt, including failed/retired variants; count all exploratory work before a new sealed competition
competition.selection_rule: One contract per game per strategy; sort eligible offers by frozen conservative EV, then stable market ID; reserve exposure before settlement, cap at five games/day. Abstentions and all evaluated offers logged.
competition.notes: All thresholds are conservative project design choices, not official standards or a substitute for a preregistered power calculation. Freeze a common future test window, eligible offer universe, fees, settlement and drawdown policy before entries; no rank across different windows or categories. No staking escalation or real-money execution.

source_rights.rule: NBA terms section 9(iv) states NBA Statistics may not be used in connection with any gambling activity, including legal gambling activity. No separate permission is evidenced.
source_rights.research_boundary: Frozen, attributed statistical audit and non-commercial methods demonstration only; no executable line or wagering signal is released.
